title: PluginDescriptor
description: One installed plugin as discovered by plugin_scan (phase 3). Emitter contract: readers must tolerate unknown fields (D-06 discipline — deliberately no additionalProperties:false). uid format: 'clap:<bundle-path>#<clap-plugin-id>' or 'lv2:<plugin-uri>'.

uid.description: Stable identity across scans and project saves; the value a project references, never an index.

path.description: Bundle file (CLAP) or bundle dir (LV2). Informational; machine-local.

isInstrument.description: True for note-input->audio plugins. AURA v1 hosts instruments on midi tracks; effects come with the insert-chain round.

audioInputs.description: 0 for CLAP descriptors until instantiation (port counts need the audio-ports extension).
